display.text:
# Context Pack: `durable-operation-spine` — App durable operation spine

Target: ultraplan-go @ 50d6f0d25ff273f4cb956f11e6030376108110bc (working tree clean except untracked `.ultraplan/`).
Planning context: ultraplan-workspace @ ab12dc38059c9bf485f9aced9075bcd7d924cac5.
Domain: durability-core. Risk: critical. Descriptive only — no defect judgments.

## 1. Purpose

`internal/app` owns the single accept-before-execute chokepoint shared by CLI, TUI, and web: before any runtime-backed work starts, the operation is durably accepted and claimed in `.ultraplan/run-control.db`, and every observable event is committed to that store before it is delivered to any live consumer. Two run tiers exist: OUTER "operation" runs (`Target.Kind="operation"`, one per user-visible operation, managed by `durableOperationManager`) and INNER "runtime" runs (one per agentwrap/OpenCode `StartRun`, managed by `controlledRuntime`), correlated via `Correlation.ProductRunID = ParentRun(ctx)` — the outer context carries its RunID via `runcontrol.WithParentRun` (runcontrol/context.go:7-25). The spine also mints the QA writer-token handoff that lets sprint code fence its private state writes on the outer run's lease. Storage mechanics (accept/claim/append/heartbeat/terminal/reconcile SQL) belong to surface `run-journal-fencing`; this pack covers the app-layer behavior built on top.

## 2. Entrypoints and control flow

### 2.1 Process wiring (`run_control.go:23-95`)
`newRunControlState()` (:32) mints ONE process owner (`currentRunOwner` → `runcontrol.NewProcessOwner`) at CLI start; `dependencies.runControl` holds it for the whole process (app.go:108-124, :189-200). `runControlState.repository(ctx, root, policies...)` (:37-75) caches one SQLiteRepository + LocalFileLogger + retention policy per workspace root; a cached repository with a DIFFERENT policy errors ("retention policy changed during the process lifetime", :47-49); first open runs startup `Reconcile` and fails closed (:66-70). `Close()` (:77-91) closes pools/loggers during process shutdown. Retention policy derived from config with ignored parse errors (`runControlRetentionPolicy` :153-157). `controlledRuntimeFor` (:140-151) resolves the cached repository and wraps any `StartRun`-shaped base runtime in a `controlledRuntime` carrying repository+owner. Used by `sprintRuntimeService` (sprint_commands.go:685-707, injected via `WithRuntime(controlled, req)`), study `runLoopService`/`runAllService`/`executionService` (study_commands.go:338, :695, :873).

### 2.2 Outer accept — `durableOperationManager.AcceptOperation` (durable_operations.go:97-138)
Input: `Confirmation` (normally produced by `PrepareOperation`, operations.go:211-359) + caller-supplied digest string. Sequence: build `Target{Kind:"operation", Operation=string(req.Kind), Project/Sprint/Study/Stage/Task}` → `repository.Accept(Acceptance{ProductStatus:"prepared", OperationAlias:digest, ConfirmationDigest:digest})` (:103-105). On `ErrConflict` WITH non-empty digest only: resolve alias → return `{RunID, Context: caller ctx unchanged, Existing:true, Lifecycle}` (:106-112) — no claim, no fence, no ownership. Any other Accept error fails closed (:113-115). Then `Claim{Lease: OwnerLeaseDuration=15s}` (:116-119), fence assembled from attempt (:120), first `lifecycle=running` append via `appendRunEventWithRetry`; if THAT fails, proposes `TerminalPersistenceLost` ("operation start persistence failed") on a detached 30 s context using the just-minted fence BEFORE returning the error (:121-129). Success path: `operationCtx = WithCancel(WithParentRun(ctx, RunID))` plus a context value `durableOperationOwnership{repository, fence}` (:130-131); ownership stored in per-instance map `m.owned[RunID]` (:132-135); control goroutine spawned (:136); returns `{RunID, Context: operationCtx, Lifecycle:"running"}`.

### 2.3 QA writer-token handoff (`qaOwnershipFromContext` :140-156)
Extracts `durableOperationOwnership` from ctx; builds `sprint.QAWriterToken{RunID, OperationalAttemptID, FencingGeneration}` (sprint/qa_types.go:179-191) plus a fence closure: full struct equality against the minted token else `ErrStaleFence` (:147-149); on match performs `repository.Heartbeat(context.WithTimeout(context.WithoutCancel(ctx), 30s), fence, 15s lease)` (:150-153) — heartbeating survives outer-context cancellation for bounded post-run writes. Consumers: `durableCLICommand.QAWriterToken()` (:64-69) used by `sprint qa run/resume` (sprint_commands.go:419-442: token+fence → `WithQAWriterFence(fence)` → `RunQA(durable.Context(), ...)`); and `sharedOperationRunner` OperationQAStart/QAResume reads the SAME context value from the accepted operation ctx (operation_runner.go:114-130). Sprint side: `checkWriter` requires a configured fence before every QA publish (sprint/qa_state.go:453-465); without an installed fence sprint falls back to comparing against `req.WriterToken` (sprint/qa.go:260-267).

### 2.4 Event recording + coalescing (`RecordOperationEvent` :158-221)
Adapter emit callbacks call this with `context.Background()`. Unknown RunID → `(false, ErrNotFound)` (:162-164). Per-operation `eventMu` serializes: event type = progress, or warning when `State==OperationFailed` (:167-170); dedup key = concatenation of type/stage/task/phase-state/summary/event-type/kind/tool/reason/detail (:171); identical progress within `ProgressCoalesceWindow`=250 ms (measured against wall-clock `time.Now().UTC()`) increments an in-memory omission counter instead of appending (:174-181, returns `(false,nil)` so adapters ALSO suppress local display). Non-coalesced events build payload {state,type,count "done/total"} plus optional phase_state/summary/tool_*/provider/model/harness keys when non-empty (:182-195); pending coalesced count flushes into the draft's Omission metadata (:196-207); append via `appendRunEventWithRetry`; append error calls `owned.cancel()` and returns the error (:208-216); progress bookkeeping updated only after commit (:217-219).

### 2.5 Manager control goroutine (`controlOperation` :223-264)
1 s ticker (`OwnerTickInterval`, model.go:514): Snapshot poll (:235) — error ⇒ cancel+exit silently (:236-239); `CancellationRequested` ⇒ fenced `AcknowledgeCancellation` then cancel (:240-247); heartbeat every ≥5 s (`HeartbeatInterval`) (:248-254); `Reconcile` every ≥10 s (`ReconciliationInterval`) (:255-261). Any of these errors cancels and exits WITHOUT surfacing or persisting a diagnostic. Exit conditions: ctx done, `owned.stop` closed, or first tick error. `FinishOperation` joins via `owned.done`.

### 2.6 Finish + terminal mapping (`FinishOperation` :266-300)
Pops ownership under mutex (unknown id ⇒ nil, no-op success :267-273). Under `eventMu`: flush trailing coalesced omissions as an omission event; a flush failure becomes `runErr` only when no other error exists (:274-282). Then close(stop) → wait done → owned.cancel() (:283-285). Outcome mapping order (:286-297): `errors.Is(runErr, DeadlineExceeded)` → timed_out; `errors.Is(runErr, Canceled)` OR `state==cancelled` → cancelled; other `runErr != nil` OR `state==failed` → failed; `state==partial` → interrupted; default succeeded. Terminal proposed with retry on detached-or-bounded caller ctx (:298-299).

### 2.7 CLI envelope (`beginDurableCLICommand` :49-60, `durableCLICommand` :37-91, `finishDurableCLICommand` :86-91)
Resolves repository via `runRepository` (run_commands.go:42-59: workspace discover → config → cached repo), creates a FRESH manager per command over the shared process owner, accepts with EMPTY digest (`Confirmation{Request:request}` — CLI never runs PrepareOperation/fingerprints; durable_operations.go:55). `Context()` exposes the accepted ctx; product code runs inside it. `Finish(runErr)`: state = cancelled if `accepted.Context.Err()!=nil` (checked FIRST), else failed if runErr, else complete (:71-77); terminal proposal on a detached 30 s ctx (:78-83); accept failures exit classified `ExitRuntime` "run-control.accept". Callers: exactly 10 sites — sprint flow/verify/execute/qa-run-resume/review/smoke (sprint_commands.go:237, :292, :338, :419, :483, :539) and study resume/run-all/analysis/synthesis (study_commands.go:211, :555, :814, :843), each pairing with `finishDurableCLICommand` (errors.Join semantics). Pinned by source-inventory test (§10).

### 2.8 Inner runtime runs — `controlledRuntime.StartRun` (run_control.go:159-343)
Target from request (`targetFromRuntimeRequest` :392-415: Kind=PromptRef.OwnerKind else study/sprint/"runtime"; Operation=Purpose else stage/task-kind/prompt-id/"runtime"; project/sprint/study/stage/task from bounded metadata). Correlation: `{ProductRunID: bounded(ParentRun(ctx)), ProductTaskID: TraceID}` (:161-164) — set when running under an outer operation ctx; standalone inner runs correlate empty. Accept(ProductStatus "accepted") → Claim(with correlation) → fence (:165-182). `req.Metadata` cloned and stamped with `run_control_run_id` so child code can observe its durable id (:186-187). OnEvent REPLACED by a persistence gate (:204-249): suppressed once a persistence error exists (:206-209); builds sanitized `runtimeEventDraft` (:210, §2.9); content-hash coalescing — identical progress payloads (key = type\0stage\0task\0payloadHash; hash excludes runtime_event_id/runtime_run_id/session_id, :215-227, :730-752) within 250 ms measured against event time (zero → now) collapse into omission counters; pending counts ride the next committed draft (:228-236); `appendRunEventWithRetry` commits (:237-241); ONLY THEN does the original `configuredOnEvent(event)` fire (:246-248) — persistence-gated delivery. First append failure records `persistenceErr` (once) and cancels runCtx (:196-203, :237-241). Control goroutine (:251-301) mirrors §2.5 cadences but distinguishes shutdown (runCtx already canceled ⇒ silent return) from real failure (`setPersistenceErr` :263-298). `base.StartRun(runCtx, req)` executes the actual runtime work (:302). Afterwards under lock: trailing omission flush (:303-316); cancel(); join controlDone (:317-318). If persistenceErr: propose `TerminalPersistenceLost` ("durable event persistence failed") on detached 30 s ctx, join errors (:322-331). Else `terminalOutcome(result, runErr, parentCtx)` mapping (:765-777): timeout (DeadlineExceeded in runErr/parent, or result.Error.Category=="timeout") → timed_out; cancelled (Canceled in runErr/parent, status=="can... (line truncated to 2000 chars)

### 2.9 App-side sanitization pipeline (`runtimeEventDraft` :417-545)
Type mapping (:418-439): warning/warn/error→warning; artifact/file→artifact; finding→finding; message/text/output/*reasoning*/content/delta→message; kind-based fallback (message kinds visible as messages; tool kinds stay progress). Base payload identity {runtime_event_id, runtime_run_id, session_id, type, kind} (:440-446). Tool-kind events get structured observation capture (:447-449, `captureToolObservation` :624-653): nested alias search depth ≤5 (:655-684) for call-id/name/status plus JSON-encoded arguments/result/error passed through `redactObservableValue` (:686-715 — sensitive-key keys replaced "[REDACTED]"; strings containing bearer /sk-/ghp_/github_pat_/private-key markers wholly redacted). Generic payload loop (:454-520): denylist key filter (`isSensitivePayloadKey` :547-555: secret/token/password/authorization/cookie/api_key/apikey/credential/auth substrings), key normalization ≤128 B without NUL/CR/LF, one-level map flattening with promotion allowlist {tool,title,detail,text,delta,content,message,action,state,status,native_type,line} else `parent_child` namespacing, values stringified bounded ≤32 KiB (`boundedPayloadValue` :717-728 strips NUL/CR/LF, byte-truncates), payload capped at 30 entries; display keys re-extracted up to two nesting levels (:521-529, :557-574). Omission decision (:530-537): RawPresent/RawOmitted → reason-carrying omission Count=1; else if more input fields than persisted−5 → "runtime payload truncated to safe observable fields". Everything passes through the storage-side sanitizer afterwards (surface `run-journal-fencing` §6). Target/correlation fields bounded by `boundedSafe` (≤512 B, control chars stripped :787-798).

### 2.10 Retry helpers
`appendRunEventWithRetry` (:345-356): retries ≤5 s wall deadline on `ErrUnavailable|ErrBusy` only, sleeping ≤100 ms slices honoring ctx (:374-390). `proposeRunTerminalWithRetry` (:358-368): retries until success/non-retryable, 250 ms sleeps, bounded ONLY by caller ctx (callers pass 30 s detached contexts at :125, :323, :335; CLI finish :78; web/TUI finish 30 s; QA fence heartbeat 30 s).

### 2.11 Adapter acceptance regimes (three digests, one alias table)
- CLI: digest "" — no alias row written; every invocation accepts a fresh run; dedup impossible by design.
- TUI (tui/app.go:232-279): one manager per TUI session (tui_commands.go:52); digest = hex(sha256(CanonicalRequest + "\x00" + InputFingerprint)) of the on-screen Confirmation (:236-238); Existing → result card "matching durable operation already exists" with lifecycle-as-state (:243-249); otherwise opctx swapped for accepted.Context (:250-253); emit callback gates local display on RecordOperationEvent commit but SWALLOWS errors (:287-295); finish via manager on detached 30 s ctx joined into result error (:297-304).

Inputs: OperationRequest fields from transport adapters (normalized+validated in PrepareOperation; scope charset enforced operations.go:541-557); Confirmation with canonical request, governed-input fingerprint, scopes/warnings; caller digest strings ("" / TUI hash / web session+token hash); runtime requests (PromptRef, Metadata, Prompt, TraceID, OnEvent); runtime events (arbitrary provider-shaped maps — treated as untrusted, §2.9); config-derived retention policy and runtime factory; process-lifetime `deps.ctx`. Outputs: rows in `.ultraplan/run-control.db` via the shared repository (outer+inner runs, attempts, events, aliases); `AcceptedOperation{RunID, Context, Existing, Lifecycle}`; OperationEvents to adapters (SSE/TUI stream) gated on commit; `OperationResult` with typed error envelopes (operations.go:751-796); `QAWriterToken` + fence closure handed to sprint; injected `run_control_run_id` metadata into runtime requests; child execution delegated to base runtime (OpenCode network sessions — outside this surface); classified CLI exit codes (`ExitRuntime` on accept/finish failure).

## 4. Authoritative state

- Durable authority is `.ultraplan/run-control.db` (schema/ownership: surface `run-journal-fencing`). This surface WRITES: outer operation rows (Target.Kind="operation", ProductStatus "prepared"), claims with the single process owner, operation-scope events (progress/warning/lifecycle/omission/terminal), aliases named by adapter digest, terminal proposals. It READS: Snapshots (cancellation state, liveness) every 1 s per active run tier.
- In-memory, per-manager-instance: `m.owned[RunID]` {fence, cancel, stop/done channels, eventMu, coalescing state} (durable_operations.go:14-32); per-controlledRuntime closure state (eventMu, persistenceErr, coalescing state) (run_control.go:189-203).
- Process-wide: `runControlState` repositories/loggers/policies per workspace root + one Owner (run_control.go:23-30); managers created per command (CLI), per TUI session, or per serve process (serve_commands.go:81).
- Derived product state written THROUGH fences by sprint (QA state files) belongs to surface `sprint-qa-investigation`; the spine only guarantees heartbeat-backed fencing.

## 5. Invariants (as implemented)

- Accept-before-execute: no child runtime work begins until Accept+Claim(+first append for operations; Accept+Claim for runtime runs) succeed; acceptance-persistence failure prevents base.StartRun entirely (test-pinned, §10).
- Persistence-gated delivery: display/downstream callbacks fire only after the corresponding Append commits, in both spine variants (run_control.go:246-248; web publishAppEvent; TUI emit gating).
- One claim per run lifetime, one terminal winner, monotonic sequences: inherited from runcontrol CAS/fencing (dependency surface); this surface always operates through freshly minted per-attempt fences and never mutates rows directly.
- Fail-closed on persistence loss: mid-run append/heartbeat/poll/reconcile failure cancels the run context (work drains through cancellation) and ends in a `persistence_lost` terminal proposed on a detached context; start-time append failure terminalizes before returning.
- Coalescing never loses counts: collapsed duplicates accumulate into Omission {reason, count, first/last} carried by the next committed event or flushed at finish; committed=false also suppresses duplicate local display.
- Cancellation path: external request persisted (ownerless) → observed within ≤1 s tick → fenced AcknowledgeCancellation → local context cancel → product drains → terminal arbitration decides cancelled-vs-completed with single-winner guarantee.
- Detached-terminal discipline: every finish/terminal/QA-heartbeat write uses a fresh ≤30 s background context (`context.Background()`/`WithoutCancel`), so shutdown or run-context cancellation cannot prevent terminal commit; append retries are strictly 5 s-bounded.
- Single process owner: all claims of one process share Owner.ID; fencing generations distinguish attempts.
- Boundedness at the boundary: target fields ≤512 B, payload values ≤32 KiB, payload ≤30 entries, keys ≤128 B, control bytes stripped before storage validation sees them.
- Structural pinning: runtime-backed CLI entries must cross `beginDurableCLICommand` (inventory test, §10); TUI/web must go through `DurableOperationManager.AcceptOperation` (capability interface assertion pattern).

## 6. Trust boundaries

- Transport → server: `ExpectedFingerprint` stripped and recomputed server-side; stale fingerprint rejected before runner dispatch (operations.go:215, :376-386). Confirmation tokens consumed once server-side (web preparation store); dedup keys derived server-side from session+token (security.go:448-451). The digest persisted into `operation_aliases`/`confirmation_digest` is always the server-computed hash, never raw transport data.
- Runtime/provider events → durable store: untrusted maps pass the app-side pipeline (denylist keys, redaction markers, bounds, flattening caps, §2.9) AND the runcontrol storage sanitizer; dropped detail becomes Omission metadata, never silence.
- Context-carried capability: `durableOperationOwnership` (repository + fence) travels in context values; QA token equality (struct compare incl. generation) is the only check that a caller presenting a token owns the fence; possession of the ctx (or token) IS the authority.
- Workspace-local trust domain: any local process may open the same db and accept/claim/cancel; no authorization layer between adapters and repository (inherited posture from dependency surface).
- Child-process boundary: `run_control_run_id` metadata injection clones the caller's metadata map before mutation (run_control.go:186-187); prompt content itself is never persisted here (test-pinned "never persisted").

## 7. External effects & cancellation/retry/restart/error semantics

Effects: runcontrol db rows/WAL via shared pool; child runtime execution (network sessions, provider APIs — owned by platform/runtime surfaces); sprint/study/QA workspace file mutations triggered by product code running INSIDE accepted contexts; stdout/stderr presentation. No direct filesystem writes by this layer beyond what repository/logger do.

Acceptance failure ⇒ operation never exists beyond its accepted row (if any); CLI exits ExitRuntime; web handler surfaces error (unless degraded mode). Claim failure after successful Accept leaves an accepted-unclaimed row for reconciliation (grace 45 s — dependency surface). Start-append failure ⇒ persistence_lost terminal, start aborts. Mid-run persistence failure ⇒ runCtx cancel → base runtime observes cancellation → persistence_lost terminal; error joined into returned error (runtime tier) or implicit via context (operation tier). Heartbeat/poll/reconcile failure ⇒ same cancel path (manager variant silent; runtime variant recorded). Retry posture: appends ≤5 s on Unavailable/Busy; terminals effectively until 30 s ctx expiry. Restart/crash: abandoned outer runs keep leases expiring at 15 s; reconciliation (startup + periodic, dependency surface) terminalizes them interrupted/uncertain using birth identity; restarted work is a NEW run correlated by ParentRun/ProductRunID, never adopted. Shutdown: process Close() closes pools last; all terminal proposals ride detached contexts; web drain records cleanup-uncertain via separate capability (web_usecases.go:540-561 — adjacent seam).

## 8. Immediate surface dependencies

- `run-journal-fencing` (internal/runcontrol): ALL storage semantics (accept/claim/fence/CAS/terminal/reconciliation/quota/sanitizer); constants imported (model.go:508-519, :13); WithParentRun correlation helper.
- `shared-usecase-vocabulary`: three acceptance regimes converging on one alias table (seam three-acceptance-regimes-one-alias); DTO vocabulary in run_usecases/web_usecases.
- `run-cli-observation` + `web-operation-hub-sse`: consumers of the committed journal; replay loops duplicate cadence constants; hub substitutes durable ids (web/operations.go:188).
- `sprint-*` (esp. `sprint-qa-investigation`): consumes QAWriterToken/fence; sprint services execute inside accepted contexts via `sprintRuntimeService`; inner sprint runtime runs inherit ParentRun correlation.
- `study-runloop-scheduler`/`study-task-execution`: study services wrap controlledRuntime identically (study_commands.go:338/:695/:873).
- `process-execution` / `opencode-agent-runtime`: the wrapped base runtimes behind controlledRuntime.
- `config-inspection-health`: retention knobs feeding runControlRetentionPolicy; health commands read the same repository.
- `product-state-mirror`: second pool on same db file (no direct interaction from this layer).

## 9. Contracts (CURRENT-CONTRACT evidence)

TRD.md (workspace projects/ultraplan-go/docs): L396 mutating/runtime-backed work requires "a server-issued, short-lived confirmation bound to the normalized request and current governed-input fingerprint"; L2202 "Acceptance … is atomic with durable run creation and happens before child execution. If required acceptance persistence fails, the child does not start. Event records are redacted before persistence, assigned monotonically increasing per-run sequences, and committed before live fan-out"; L2223 + L2672 require safe fail-closed/degraded behavior for acceptance, mid-run append, heartbeat, terminal persistence failures; L2367 partial success must be detectable and recoverable; Sprint 35 requirements (sprints/35-durable-run-observability/requirements.md L24, L40-41): reconciliation never infers success; exactly one terminal outcome wins across races. Code-comment contracts: operations.go:129-132 (fingerprint server authority), :38-41 (non-reversible digest), operation_runner.go:15-17 (single runtime-backed implementation; adapters own presentation/confirmation only), durable_operations.go:34-36 (CLI counterpart keeps manager alive for whole command), runcontrol/context.go:7 (parent-run correlation).

## 10. Tests (evidence map)

App package (baseline green; review/baseline):
- run_control_test.go: forwards session deletion when base supports it (:25-34); accept→claim→commit-before-delivery incl. delivery callback reading exactly 1 committed event, parent correlation, sanitized journal with secret dropped + omission present + terminal second (:49-109); acceptance-persistence failure prevents child start (:111-129); runtime failure persisted as failed terminal without leaking error text (:131-157).
- durable_operations_test.go: full outer lifecycle accept→claim→ParentRun ctx→running snapshot→QA token/fence roundtrip incl. WithoutCancel cleanup fence and stale-generation rejection→record event (message omitted, tool/phase payload retained)→finish→succeeded LastSequence=3 (:11-90); cross-manager alias dedup Existing:true + closed-repository accept fails non-conflict (:92-124).
- run_tool_observability_test.go: tool arguments/result preserved redacted (:10); usage metrics not mistaken for tool IO (:35).
- run_control_inventory_test.go: pins beginDurableCLICommand counts (sprint 6, study 4) AND presence of each runtime-backed entry marker by counting source strings (:22-51).
- web_operations_test.go: prepare normalizes fingerprints/no side effects (:15); stale fingerprint rejected before runner (:59); QA prep rejects caller-owned controls (:148).
- Adapter tests: web operations_test/integration_test cover hub dedup, SSE shapes, degradation flags; tui_commands_test covers TUI wiring smoke.
Storage-side behaviors (claim races, reconcile matrix, fault injection) are pinned in internal/runcontrol tests (see sibling pack §10).

Coverage gaps noted factually: no test drives manager `controlOperation` tick paths (ack/heartbeat/reconcile branches) directly; no test covers RecordOperationEvent append-error → owned.cancel propagation end-to-end; web degrade-mode (durable nil) exercised only via fake capability absence in unit tests; no test pins TUI digest derivation or web confirmationDedupKey composition; no test covers FinishOperation omission-flush-failure outcome mapping.

## 11. Explicit unknowns / open questions (for later reviewers)

1. Ownership scoping asymmetry: alias dedup is repository-wide but `m.owned` is per-manager-instance; a different manager (or process) cannot finish/record for a run it did not accept (nil-op success / ErrNotFound). Cross-instance finishing relies solely on lease expiry + reconciliation.
2. Manager-tier tick failures (snapshot/ack/heartbeat/reconcile) cancel silently — no surfaced diagnostic, no persisted warning event, in contrast to the runtime tier's setPersistenceErr recording.
3. Two independent coalescing implementations with different key spaces (full tuple vs payload-hash) and different clocks (wall now vs event.Time fallback now); parity between them is unpinned.
4. `payloadHash` is plain concatenated string comparison despite the name; excludes exactly three identity keys.
5. `RecordOperationEvent`/finish-flush hold the per-operation mutex across Append including the 5 s retry window — serialization point per operation.
6. TUI emit swallows RecordOperationEvent errors (no display change, no local signal); internal owned.cancel still fires.
7. Alias-conflict Existing results carry the CALLER's ctx unchanged, no fence, possibly-terminal lifecycle; each adapter projects it differently (refresh path vs static card).
8. Start-append failure path terminalizes a run that executed nothing as persistence_lost — intended shape unstated.
9. Web degrade mode (durable capability absent) continues fully in-memory with hub-generated ids and NO persistence gating — designed fallback; which deployments hit it depends on wiring (serve always wires one today).
10. `deps.ctx` is process-lifetime; Ctrl-C/signal propagation into CLI operation contexts depends on cfg.Context wiring outside this surface.
11. Inventory pinning works by literal string-counting two specific files; new runtime-backed entry points elsewhere would not trip it unless added to the table.
12. `boundedSafe`/`boundedPayloadValue` truncate raw bytes (may split multi-byte runes) before storage-side validation.
13. QA fence equality is whole-struct comparison; token reuse across attempts fails only via generation mismatch — dependency on runcontrol's monotonic generation guarantee.
14. Abandoned-but-unfinshed outer operations (adapter crash between accept and finish) leave running rows until 15 s lease + grace reconciliation; no app-level sweeper exists.
15. `RecordOperationCleanupUncertain`/`ReconcileOperations` (web shutdown drain) write product-owned cleanup markers, not runcontrol rows — relationship to outer run terminals is defined only by convention.

— End of context pack. Descriptive only; no defect claims made or implied.

# Context Pack: `durable-operation-spine` — App durable operation spine

Target: ultraplan-go @ 50d6f0d25ff273f4cb956f11e6030376108110bc (working tree clean except untracked `.ultraplan/`).
Planning context: ultraplan-workspace @ ab12dc38059c9bf485f9aced9075bcd7d924cac5.
Domain: durability-core. Risk: critical. Descriptive only — no defect judgments.

## 1. Purpose

`internal/app` owns the single accept-before-execute chokepoint shared by CLI, TUI, and web: before any runtime-backed work starts, the operation is durably accepted and claimed in `.ultraplan/run-control.db`, and every observable event is committed to that store before it is delivered to any live consumer. Two run tiers exist: OUTER "operation" runs (`Target.Kind="operation"`, one per user-visible operation, managed by `durableOperationManager`) and INNER "runtime" runs (one per agentwrap/OpenCode `StartRun`, managed by `controlledRuntime`), correlated via `Correlation.ProductRunID = ParentRun(ctx)` — the outer context carries its RunID via `runcontrol.WithParentRun` (runcontrol/context.go:7-25). The spine also mints the QA writer-token handoff that lets sprint code fence its private state writes on the outer run's lease. Storage mechanics (accept/claim/append/heartbeat/terminal/reconcile SQL) belong to surface `run-journal-fencing`; this pack covers the app-layer behavior built on top.

## 2. Entrypoints and control flow

### 2.1 Process wiring (`run_control.go:23-95`)
`newRunControlState()` (:32) mints ONE process owner (`currentRunOwner` → `runcontrol.NewProcessOwner`) at CLI start; `dependencies.runControl` holds it for the whole process (app.go:108-124, :189-200). `runControlState.repository(ctx, root, policies...)` (:37-75) caches one SQLiteRepository + LocalFileLogger + retention policy per workspace root; a cached repository with a DIFFERENT policy errors ("retention policy changed during the process lifetime", :47-49); first open runs startup `Reconcile` and fails closed (:66-70). `Close()` (:77-91) closes pools/loggers during process shutdown. Retention policy derived from config with ignored parse errors (`runControlRetentionPolicy` :153-157). `controlledRuntimeFor` (:140-151) resolves the cached repository and wraps any `StartRun`-shaped base runtime in a `controlledRuntime` carrying repository+owner. Used by `sprintRuntimeService` (sprint_commands.go:685-707, injected via `WithRuntime(controlled, req)`), study `runLoopService`/`runAllService`/`executionService` (study_commands.go:338, :695, :873).

### 2.2 Outer accept — `durableOperationManager.AcceptOperation` (durable_operations.go:97-138)
Input: `Confirmation` (normally produced by `PrepareOperation`, operations.go:211-359) + caller-supplied digest string. Sequence: build `Target{Kind:"operation", Operation=string(req.Kind), Project/Sprint/Study/Stage/Task}` → `repository.Accept(Acceptance{ProductStatus:"prepared", OperationAlias:digest, ConfirmationDigest:digest})` (:103-105). On `ErrConflict` WITH non-empty digest only: resolve alias → return `{RunID, Context: caller ctx unchanged, Existing:true, Lifecycle}` (:106-112) — no claim, no fence, no ownership. Any other Accept error fails closed (:113-115). Then `Claim{Lease: OwnerLeaseDuration=15s}` (:116-119), fence assembled from attempt (:120), first `lifecycle=running` append via `appendRunEventWithRetry`; if THAT fails, proposes `TerminalPersistenceLost` ("operation start persistence failed") on a detached 30 s context using the just-minted fence BEFORE returning the error (:121-129). Success path: `operationCtx = WithCancel(WithParentRun(ctx, RunID))` plus a context value `durableOperationOwnership{repository, fence}` (:130-131); ownership stored in per-instance map `m.owned[RunID]` (:132-135); control goroutine spawned (:136); returns `{RunID, Context: operationCtx, Lifecycle:"running"}`.

### 2.3 QA writer-token handoff (`qaOwnershipFromContext` :140-156)
Extracts `durableOperationOwnership` from ctx; builds `sprint.QAWriterToken{RunID, OperationalAttemptID, FencingGeneration}` (sprint/qa_types.go:179-191) plus a fence closure: full struct equality against the minted token else `ErrStaleFence` (:147-149); on match performs `repository.Heartbeat(context.WithTimeout(context.WithoutCancel(ctx), 30s), fence, 15s lease)` (:150-153) — heartbeating survives outer-context cancellation for bounded post-run writes. Consumers: `durableCLICommand.QAWriterToken()` (:64-69) used by `sprint qa run/resume` (sprint_commands.go:419-442: token+fence → `WithQAWriterFence(fence)` → `RunQA(durable.Context(), ...)`); and `sharedOperationRunner` OperationQAStart/QAResume reads the SAME context value from the accepted operation ctx (operation_runner.go:114-130). Sprint side: `checkWriter` requires a configured fence before every QA publish (sprint/qa_state.go:453-465); without an installed fence sprint falls back to comparing against `req.WriterToken` (sprint/qa.go:260-267).

61: ## 5. Invariants (as implemented)
62: 
63: - Accept-before-execute: no child runtime work begins until Accept+Claim(+first append for operations; Accept+Claim for runtime runs) succeed; acceptance-persistence failure prevents base.StartRun entirely (test-pinned, §10).

67: - Coalescing never loses counts: collapsed duplicates accumulate into Omission {reason, count, first/last} carried by the next committed event or flushed at finish; committed=false also suppresses duplicate local display.

74: ## 6. Trust boundaries
75: 
76: - Transport → server: `ExpectedFingerprint` stripped and recomputed server-side; stale fingerprint rejected before runner dispatch (operations.go:215, :376-386). 80: - Child-process boundary: `run_control_run_id` metadata injection clones the caller's metadata map before mutation (run_control.go:186-187); prompt content itself is never persisted here (test-pinned "never persisted").

86: Acceptance failure ⇒ operation never exists beyond its accepted row (if any); CLI exits ExitRuntime; web handler surfaces error (unless degraded mode). Mid-run persistence failure ⇒ runCtx cancel → base runtime observes cancellation → persistence_lost terminal; error joined into returned error (runtime tier) or implicit via context (operation tier). Heartbeat/poll/reconcile failure ⇒ same cancel path (manager variant silent; runtime variant recorded). Retry posture: appends ≤5 s on Unavailable/Busy; terminals effectively until 30 s ctx expiry. Restart/crash: abandoned outer runs keep leases expiring at 15 s; reconciliation (startup + periodic, dependency surface) terminalizes them interrupted/uncertain using birth identity; restarted work is a NEW run correlated by ParentRun/ProductRunID, never adopted. Shutdown: process Close() closes pools last; all terminal proposals ride detached contexts; web drain records cleanup-uncertain via separate capability (web_usecases.go:540-561 — adjacent seam).

91: - `shared-usecase-vocabulary`: three acceptance regimes converging on one alias table (seam three-acceptance-regimes-one-alias); DTO vocabulary in run_usecases/web_usecases.

101: TRD.md (workspace projects/ultraplan-go/docs): L396 mutating/runtime-backed work requires "a server-issued, short-lived confirmation bound to the normalized request and current governed-input fingerprint"; L2202 "Acceptance … is atomic with durable run creation and happens before child execution. 102: 
103: ## 10. Tests (evidence map)
104: 
105: App package (baseline green; review/baseline):
106: - run_control_test.go: forwards session deletion when base supports it (:25-34); accept→claim→commit-before-delivery incl. delivery callback reading exactly 1 committed event, parent correlation, sanitized journal with secret dropped + omission present + terminal second (:49-109); acceptance-persistence failure prevents child start (:111-129); runtime failure persisted as failed terminal without leaking error text (:131-157).
107: - durable_operations_test.go: full outer lifecycle accept→claim→ParentRun ctx→running snapshot→QA token/fence roundtrip incl. WithoutCancel cleanup fence and stale-generation rejection→record event (message omitted, tool/phase payload retained)→finish→succeeded LastSequence=3 (:11-90); cross-manager alias dedup Existing:true + closed-repository accept fails non-conflict (:92-124).
108: - run_tool_observability_test.go: tool arguments/result preserved redacted (:10); usage metrics not mistaken for tool IO (:35).
109: - run_control_inventory_test.go: pins beginDurableCLICommand counts (sprint 6, study 4) AND presence of each runtime-backed entry marker by counting source strings (:22-51).
110: - web_operations_test.go: prepare normalizes fingerprints/no side effects (:15); stale fingerprint rejected before runner (:59); QA prep rejects caller-owned controls (:148).

112: Storage-side behaviors (claim races, reconcile matrix, fault injection) are pinned in internal/runcontrol tests (see sibling pack §10).
113: 
114: Coverage gaps noted factually: no test drives manager `controlOperation` tick paths (ack/heartbeat/reconcile branches) directly; no test covers RecordOperationEvent append-error → owned.cancel propagation end-to-end; web degrade-mode (durable nil) exercised only via fake capability absence in unit tests; no test pins TUI digest derivation or web confirmationDedupKey composition; no test covers FinishOperation omission-flush-failure outcome mapping.
115: 
116: ## 11. Explicit unknowns / open questions (for later reviewers)
117: 
118: 1. Ownership scoping asymmetry: alias dedup is repository-wide but `m.owned` is per-manager-instance; a different manager (or process) cannot finish/record for a run it did not accept (nil-op success / ErrNotFound). Cross-instance finishing relies solely on lease expiry + reconciliation.
119: 2. Manager-tier tick failures (snapshot/ack/heartbeat/reconcile) cancel silently — no surfaced diagnostic, no persisted warning event, in contrast to the runtime tier's setPersistenceErr recording.
120: 3. Two independent coalescing implementations with different key spaces (full tuple vs payload-hash) and different clocks (wall now vs event.Time fallback now); parity between them is unpinned.
121: 4. `payloadHash` is plain concatenated string comparison despite the name; excludes exactly three identity keys.
122: 5. `RecordOperationEvent`/finish-flush hold the per-operation mutex across Append including the 5 s retry window — serialization point per operation.
123: 6. TUI emit swallows RecordOperationEvent errors (no display change, no local signal); internal owned.cancel still fires.
124: 7. Alias-conflict Existing results carry the CALLER's ctx unchanged, no fence, possibly-terminal lifecycle; each adapter projects it differently (refresh path vs static card).
125: 8. Start-append failure path terminalizes a run that executed nothing as persistence_lost — intended shape unstated.
126: 9. Web degrade mode (durable capability absent) continues fully in-memory with hub-generated ids and NO persistence gating — designed fallback; which deployments hit it depends on wiring (serve always wires one today).
127: 10. `deps.ctx` is process-lifetime; Ctrl-C/signal propagation into CLI operation contexts depends on cfg.Context wiring outside this surface.
128: 11. Inventory pinning works by literal string-counting two specific files; new runtime-backed entry points elsewhere would not trip it unless added to the table.
129: 12. `boundedSafe`/`boundedPayloadValue` truncate raw bytes (may split multi-byte runes) before storage-side validation.
130: 13. QA fence equality is whole-struct comparison; token reuse across attempts fails only via generation mismatch — dependency on runcontrol's monotonic generation guarantee.
131: 14. Abandoned-but-unfinshed outer operations (adapter crash between accept and finish) leave running rows until 15 s lease + grace reconciliation; no app-level sweeper exists.
132: 15. `RecordOperationCleanupUncertain`/`ReconcileOperations` (web shutdown drain) write product-owned cleanup markers, not runcontrol rows — relationship to outer run terminals is defined only by convention.

1: # Context Pack: `durable-operation-spine` — App durable operation spine
2: 
3: Target: ultraplan-go @ 50d6f0d25ff273f4cb956f11e6030376108110bc (working tree clean except untracked `.ultraplan/`).

5: Domain: durability-core. Risk: critical. Descriptive only — no defect judgments.
6: 
7: ## 1. Purpose
8: 
9: `internal/app` owns the single accept-before-execute chokepoint shared by CLI, TUI, and web: before any runtime-backed work starts, the operation is durably accepted and claimed in `.ultraplan/run-control.db`, and every observable event is committed to that store before it is delivered to any live consumer. Two run tiers exist: OUTER "operation" runs (`Target.Kind="operation"`, one per user-visible operation, managed by `durableOperationManager`) and INNER "runtime" runs (one per agentwrap/OpenCode `StartRun`, managed by `controlledRuntime`), correlated via `Correlation.ProductRunID = ParentRun(ctx)` — the outer context carries its RunID via `runcontrol.WithParentRun` (runcontrol/context.go:7-25). The spine also mints the QA writer-token handoff that lets sprint code fence its private state writes on the outer run's lease. Storage mechanics (accept/claim/append/heartbeat/terminal/reconcile SQL) belong to surface `run-journal-fencing`; this pack covers the app-layer behavior built on top.
10: 
11: ## 2. Entrypoints and control flow
12: 
13: ### 2.1 Process wiring (`run_control.go:23-95`)
14: `newRunControlState()` (:32) mints ONE process owner (`currentRunOwner` → `runcontrol.NewProcessOwner`) at CLI start; `dependencies.runControl` holds it for the whole process (app.go:108-124, :189-200). `runControlState.repository(ctx, root, policies...)` (:37-75) caches one SQLiteRepository + LocalFileLogger + retention policy per workspace root; a cached repository with a DIFFERENT policy errors ("retention policy changed during the process lifetime", :47-49); first open runs startup `Reconcile` and fails closed (:66-70). `Close()` (:77-91) closes pools/loggers during process shutdown. Retention policy derived from config with ignored parse errors (`runControlRetentionPolicy` :153-157). `controlledRuntimeFor` (:140-151) resolves the cached repository and wraps any `StartRun`-shaped base runtime in a `controlledRuntime` carrying repository+owner. Used by `sprintRuntimeService` (sprint_commands.go:685-707, injected via `WithRuntime(controlled, req)`), study `runLoopService`/`runAllService`/`executionService` (study_commands.go:338, :695, :873).
15: 
16: ### 2.2 Outer accept — `durableOperationManager.AcceptOperation` (durable_operations.go:97-138)
17: Input: `Confirmation` (normally produced by `PrepareOperation`, operations.go:211-359) + caller-supplied digest string. Sequence: build `Target{Kind:"operation", Operation=string(req.Kind), Project/Sprint/Study/Stage/Task}` → `repository.Accept(Acceptance{ProductStatus:"prepared", OperationAlias:digest, ConfirmationDigest:digest})` (:103-105). On `ErrConflict` WITH non-empty digest only: resolve alias → return `{RunID, Context: caller ctx unchanged, Existing:true, Lifecycle}` (:106-112) — no claim, no fence, no ownership. Any other Accept error fails closed (:113-115). Then `Claim{Lease: OwnerLeaseDuration=15s}` (:116-119), fence assembled from attempt (:120), first `lifecycle=running` append via `appendRunEventWithRetry`; if THAT fails, proposes `TerminalPersistenceLost` ("operation start persistence failed") on a detached 30 s context using the just-minted fence BEFORE returning the error (:121-129). Success path: `operationCtx = WithCancel(WithParentRun(ctx, RunID))` plus a context value `durableOperationOwnership{repository, fence}` (:130-131); ownership stored in per-instance map `m.owned[RunID]` (:132-135); control goroutine spawned (:136); returns `{RunID, Context: operationCtx, Lifecycle:"running"}`.
18: 
19: ### 2.3 QA writer-token handoff (`qaOwnershipFromContext` :140-156)
20: Extracts `durableOperationOwnership` from ctx; builds `sprint.QAWriterToken{RunID, OperationalAttemptID, FencingGeneration}` (sprint/qa_types.go:179-191) plus a fence closure: full struct equality against the minted token else `ErrStaleFence` (:147-149); on match performs `repository.Heartbeat(context.WithTimeout(context.WithoutCancel(ctx), 30s), fence, 15s lease)` (:150-153) — heartbeating survives outer-context cancellation for bounded post-run writes. Consumers: `durableCLICommand.QAWriterToken()` (:64-69) used by `sprint qa run/resume` (sprint_commands.go:419-442: token+fence → `WithQAWriterFence(fence)` → `RunQA(durable.Context(), ...)`); and `sharedOperationRunner` OperationQAStart/QAResume reads the SAME context value from the accepted operation ctx (operation_runner.go:114-130). Sprint side: `checkWriter` requires a configured fence before every QA publish (sprint/qa_state.go:453-465); without an installed fence sprint falls back to comparing against `req.WriterToken` (sprint/qa.go:260-267).
21: 
22: ### 2.4 Event recording + coalescing (`RecordOperationEvent` :158-221)
23: Adapter emit callbacks call this with `context.Background()`. Unknown RunID → `(false, ErrNotFound)` (:162-164). Per-operation `eventMu` serializes: event type = progress, or warning when `State==OperationFailed` (:167-170); dedup key = concatenation of type/stage/task/phase-state/summary/event-type/kind/tool/reason/detail (:171); identical progress within `ProgressCoalesceWindow`=250 ms (measured against wall-clock `time.Now().UTC()`) increments an in-memory omission counter instead of appending (:174-181, returns `(false,nil)` so adapters ALSO suppress local display). Non-coalesced events build payload {state,type,count "done/total"} plus optional phase_state/summary/tool_*/provider/model/harness keys when non-empty (:182-195); pending coalesced count flushes into the draft's Omission metadata (:196-207); append via `appendRunEventWithRetry`; append error calls `owned.cancel()` and returns the error (:208-216); progress bookkeeping updated only after commit (:217-219).
24: 
25: ### 2.5 Manager control goroutine (`controlOperation` :223-264)
26: 1 s ticker (`OwnerTickInterval`, model.go:514): Snapshot poll (:235) — error ⇒ cancel+exit silently (:236-239); `CancellationRequested` ⇒ fenced `AcknowledgeCancellation` then cancel (:240-247); heartbeat every ≥5 s (`HeartbeatInterval`) (:248-254); `Reconcile` every ≥10 s (`ReconciliationInterval`) (:255-261). Any of these errors cancels and exits WITHOUT surfacing or persisting a diagnostic. Exit conditions: ctx done, `owned.stop` closed, or first tick error. `FinishOperation` joins via `owned.done`.
27: 
28: ### 2.6 Finish + terminal mapping (`FinishOperation` :266-300)
29: Pops ownership under mutex (unknown id ⇒ nil, no-op success :267-273). Under `eventMu`: flush trailing coalesced omissions as an omission event; a flush failure becomes `runErr` only when no other error exists (:274-282). Then close(stop) → wait done → owned.cancel() (:283-285). Outcome mapping order (:286-297): `errors.Is(runErr, DeadlineExceeded)` → timed_out; `errors.Is(runErr, Canceled)` OR `state==cancelled` → cancelled; other `runErr != nil` OR `state==failed` → failed; `state==partial` → interrupted; default succeeded. Terminal proposed with retry on detached-or-bounded caller ctx (:298-299).
30:

232: 		case <-owned.stop:
233: 			return

236: 			if err != nil {

238: 				return

241: 				if _, _, err := m.repository.AcknowledgeCancellation(ctx, owned.fence); err != nil {
242: 					owned.cancel()

244: 				}
245: 				owned.cancel()
246: 				return

249: 				if _, err := m.repository.Heartbeat(ctx, owned.fence, runcontrol.OwnerLeaseDuration); err != nil {
250: 					owned.cancel()

252: 				}

257: 					owned.cancel()
258: 					return
259: 				}

275: 	if owned.omitted > 0 {
276: 		_, _, appendErr := appendRunEventWithRetry(ctx, m.repository, owned.fence, runcontrol.EventDraft{Type: runcontrol.EventOmission, Omission: &runcontrol.Omission{Reason: "equivalent progress coalesced", Count: owned.omitted, FirstAt: &owned.omittedFirst, LastAt: &owned.omittedLast}})

278: 			runErr = appendErr
279: 		}
280: 		owned.omitted = 0
281: 	}

283: 	close(owned.stop)
284: 	<-owned.done
285: 	owned.cancel()
286: 	outcome := runcontrol.TerminalSucceeded

288: 	switch {

291: 	case errors.Is(runErr, context.Canceled), state == OperationCancelled:
292: 		outcome, reason = runcontrol.TerminalCancelled, "operation cancelled"
293: 	case runErr != nil, state == OperationFailed:

295: 	case state == OperationPartial:

211: func (u dashboardUseCases) PrepareOperation(ctx context.Context, req OperationRequest) (Confirmation, error) {
212: 	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
213: 		return Confirmation{}, err
214: 	}
215: 	req.ExpectedFingerprint = ""
216: 	req = normalizeOperationRequest(req)
217: 	if err := validateOperationScope(req); err != nil {
218: 		return Confirmation{}, err
219: 	}
220: 	if err := validateQAOperationRequest(req); err != nil {
221: 		return Confirmation{}, err
222: 	}
223: 	if (req.Kind == OperationReviewStart || req.Kind == OperationReviewDryRun) && req.Parallelism <= 0 {
224: 		req.Parallelism = u.reviewConcurrency
225: 	}
226: 	c := Confirmation{Request: req, Subject: operationFirstNonEmpty(req.Project+"/"+req.Sprint, req.Study), Permission: "workspace policy enforced"}
227: 	switch req.Kind {
228: 	case OperationValidate, OperationPrompt, OperationFlowDryRun, OperationStageDryRun, OperationExecuteDryRun, OperationExecuteStatus, OperationReviewDryRun, OperationReviewStatus, OperationSmokeStatus, OperationQAStatus:
229: 		c.Scope = []string{req.Stage}
230: 		c.Warning = "runtime-free; no runtime-backed writes"
231: 	case OperationQADryRun:
232: 		if req.Suite == "smoke" {
233: 			smoke, err := u.sprintService().RunSmoke(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.SmokeRequest{DryRun: true})
234: 			if err != nil {
235: 				return c, err
236: 			}
237: 			c.Scope = []string{"canonical containing smoke selection", smoke.ScopeKind + " " + smoke.Scope}
238: 			c.Warning = "RUNTIME-FREE SMOKE PREFLIGHT; NO HARNESS INVOCATION"
239: 			break
240: 		}
241: 		mapped, err := u.QAMap(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
242: 		if err != nil {
243: 			return c, err
244: 		}
245: 		c.Scope = []string{fmt.Sprintf("deterministic map %s", mapped.MapFingerprint), fmt.Sprintf("%d changed paths in %d bounded shards", mapped.ChangedPaths, mapped.TotalShards)}
246: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME-FREE; TARGET AND GOVERNED INPUTS READ-ONLY; NO QA STATE WRITE"
247: 	case OperationQAStart, OperationQAResume:
248: 		if req.Suite == "smoke" {
249: 			c.Runtime, c.Mutates = true, true
250: 			c.Scope = []string{"one canonical smoke harness invocation", "one smoke.md and flow-state update"}
251: 			c.Warning = "RUNTIME + EXTERNAL HARNESS EVIDENCE; IMPLEMENTATION TARGET READ-ONLY"
252: 			break
253: 		}
254: 		mapped, err := u.QAMap(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
255: 		if err != nil {
256: 			return c, err
257: 		}
258: 		if req.Task != "" {
259: 			owned := false
260: 			for _, shard := range mapped.Shards {
261: 				owned = owned || shard.ID == req.Task
262: 			}
263: 			if !owned {
264: 				return c, fmt.Errorf("selected QA shard is not owned by the current map")
265: 			}
266: 		}
267: 		c.Runtime, c.Mutates = true, true
268: 		c.Scope = []string{fmt.Sprintf("deterministic map %s", mapped.MapFingerprint), fmt.Sprintf("bounded concurrency and %d total shards", mapped.TotalShards)}
269: 		if req.Task != "" {
270: 			c.Scope = append(c.Scope, "map-owned shard "+req.Task)
271: 		}
272: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + PRIVATE QA STATE WRITE; IMPLEMENTATION TARGET READ-ONLY"
273: 	case OperationQARecover:
274: 		c.Mutates = true
275: 		c.Scope = []string{"QA pointer, digest, interrupted ownership, flow summary, and retention reconciliation"}
276: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME-FREE QA RECOVERY; NO CHILD WORK"
277: 	case OperationSprintStatus:
278: 		c.Mutates = true
279: 		c.Scope = []string{"all sprint stages", "execute and Conformance Review state"}
280: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME-FREE; MAY REFRESH FLOW-STATE.JSON"
281: 	case OperationFlow:
282: 		c.Runtime = true
283: 		c.Mutates = true
284: 		c.Scope = []string{"planning stages through " + req.Stage}
285: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + WORKSPACE MUTATION"
286: 	case OperationStage:
287: 		c.Runtime = true
288: 		c.Mutates = true
289: 		c.Scope = []string{"selected planning stage only: " + req.Stage}
290: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + WORKSPACE MUTATION; PREREQUISITES MUST ALREADY BE VALID"
291: 	case OperationExecuteStart, OperationExecuteResume:
292: 		c.Runtime = true
293: 		c.Mutates = true
294: 		c.Scope = []string{"execute tasks"}
295: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + APPROVED TARGET MUTATION"
296: 	case OperationReviewStart:
297: 		c.Runtime = true
298: 		c.Mutates = true
299: 		c.Scope = []string{"one read-only Conformance Review worker per selected contract plus handbook", fmt.Sprintf("bounded parallelism: %d", req.Parallelism)}
300: 		if req.RestartReview {
301: 			c.Scope = append(c.Scope, "discard resumable Conformance Review checkpoints and start fresh sessions")
302: 		}
303: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + REVIEW ARTIFACT WRITE (TARGET READ-ONLY)"
304: 	case OperationSmokeDryRun, OperationSmokeStart:
305: 		preview, err := u.sprintService().RunSmoke(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.SmokeRequest{Level: req.Level, Suite: req.Suite, Test: req.Test, ForceReview: req.ForceReview, OverrideConfirmed: req.ForceReview, OverrideRationale: req.OverrideRationale, DryRun: true})
306: 		if err != nil {
307: 			return c, err
308: 		}
309: 		c.Runtime = true
310: 		c.Mutates = req.Kind == OperationSmokeStart
311: 		c.Scope = []string{fmt.Sprintf("%s %s", preview.ScopeKind, preview.Scope), preview.ScopeRationale, "prerequisites: " + strings.Join(preview.Prerequisites, ", "), "duration/cost: " + preview.DurationClass + "/" + preview.CostClass, fmt.Sprintf("timeout: %s (source: %s)", preview.EffectiveTimeout, preview.TimeoutSource), "safe command: " + preview.SafeArgv, "evidence roots: " + strings.Join(preview.EvidenceRoots, ", ")}
312: 		c.Warning = "EXTERNAL HARNESS + SMOKE ARTIFACT WRITE; RAW EVIDENCE REMAINS EXTERNAL"
313: 	case OperationVerifyDryRun, OperationVerifyStart:
314: 		c.Runtime, c.Mutates = true, req.Kind == OperationVerifyStart
315: 		c.Scope = []string{"complete execute evidence", "current Conformance Review", "Conformance Review-gated containing smoke scope"}
316: 		if req.ForceReview {
317: 			c.Scope = append(c.Scope, "DIAGNOSTIC OVERRIDE: "+req.OverrideRationale)
318: 		}
319: 		c.Warning = "ORDERED REVIEW -> SMOKE VERIFICATION; CANONICAL EVIDENCE ONLY AFTER VALIDATION"
320: 	case OperationStudyStart, OperationStudyResume:
321: 		if req.Parallelism < 1 || req.Parallelism > 64 {
322: 			return c, fmt.Errorf("parallelism must be between 1 and 64")
323: 		}
324: 		c.Runtime = true
325: 		c.Mutates = true
326: 		c.Scope = []string{fmt.Sprintf("study run-loop with %d parallel workers", req.Parallelism)}
327: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + STUDY STATE MUTATION"
328: 	case OperationStudyCancel:
329: 		c.Mutates = true
330: 		c.Scope = []string{"active study run-loop"}
331: 		c.Warning = "CANCEL ACTIVE RUN LOOP"
332: 	default:
333: 		return c, fmt.Errorf("unsupported operation %q", req.Kind)
334: 	}
335: 	if req.Project != "" {
336: 		if req.Sprint != "" {
337: 			c.Paths = []string{"projects/" + req.Project + "/sprints/" + req.Sprint}
338: 			c.DurableRefreshPath = "/api/v1/projects/" + req.Project + "/sprints/" + req.Sprint
339: 		} else {
340: 			c.Paths = []string{"projects/" + req.Project}
341: 			c.DurableRefreshPath = "/api/v1/projects/" + req.Project
342: 		}
343: 	} else {
344: 		c.Paths = []string{"studies/" + req.Study}
345: 		c.DurableRefreshPath = "/api/v1/studies/" + req.Study
346: 	}
347: 	if c.Mutates {
348: 		if req.Project != "" {
349: 			c.MutationClass = "sprint_mutation"
350: 		} else {
351: 			c.MutationClass = "study_mutation"
352: 		}
353: 	} else {
354: 		c.MutationClass = "read_only"
355: 	}
356: 	if c.Runtime {
357: 		c.ModelSource = operationRuntimeIdentity(req, u.stageRuntime)
358: 	}
359: 	c.Prerequisites = operationPrerequisites(req)
360: 	canonical, err := canonicalOperationRequest(req)
361: 	if err != nil {
362: 		return c, err
363: 	}
364: 	c.CanonicalRequest = canonical
365: 	c.GovernedInputs = governedOperationInputs(req)
366: 	fingerprintBasis := canonical + "\nruntime=" + c.ModelSource + "\nscope=" + strings.Join(c.Scope, "\x00")
367: 	fingerprint, err := fingerprintOperationInputs(u.root, fingerprintBasis, c.GovernedInputs)
368: 	if err != nil {
369: 		return c, err
370: 	}
371: 	c.InputFingerprint = fingerprint
372: 	c.Request.ExpectedFingerprint = fingerprint
373: 	return c, nil
374: }

376: func validateQAOperationRequest(req OperationRequest) error {
377: 	switch req.Kind {
378: 	case OperationQAStatus, OperationQADryRun, OperationQAStart, OperationQAResume, OperationQARecover:
379: 	default:
380: 		return nil
381: 	}
382: 	if req.Study != "" || req.Stage != "" || req.Model != "" || req.Level != "" || req.Test != "" || req.Timeout != "" || req.ForceReview || req.RestartReview || req.OverrideRationale != "" || len(req.ReviewFocus) > 0 || len(req.Sources) > 0 || len(req.Dimensions) > 0 || req.Parallelism != 0 {
383: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA operations accept only project, sprint, and a map-owned shard")
384: 	}
385: 	if req.Suite != "" && req.Suite != "smoke" {
386: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA suite must be smoke")
387: 	}
388: 	if req.Suite != "" && req.Kind != OperationQAStart && req.Kind != OperationQADryRun {
389: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA suite is valid only for start or dry-run")
390: 	}
391: 	if req.Suite != "" && req.Task != "" {
392: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA suite and shard focus are mutually exclusive")
393: 	}
394: 	if req.Task != "" && req.Kind != OperationQAStart && req.Kind != OperationQAResume {
395: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA shard is valid only for start or resume")
396: 	}
397: 	return nil
398: }

400: func (u dashboardUseCases) RunOperation(ctx context.Context, req OperationRequest, emit func(OperationEvent)) (OperationResult, error) {
401: 	expected := req.ExpectedFingerprint
402: 	req.ExpectedFingerprint = ""
403: 	prepared, err := u.PrepareOperation(ctx, req)
404: 	if err != nil {
405: 		return failedOperation(OperationResult{Subject: operationFirstNonEmpty(req.Project+"/"+req.Sprint, req.Study)}, err)
406: 	}
407: 	if expected != "" && expected != prepared.InputFingerprint {
408: 		return failedOperation(OperationResult{Subject: prepared.Subject}, ErrStaleOperation)
409: 	}
410: 	req = prepared.Request
411: 	if emit == nil {
412: 		emit = func(OperationEvent) {}
413: 	}
414: 	emit(OperationEvent{State: OperationRunning, Stage: req.Stage, Message: "operation started"})
415: 	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
416: 		return OperationResult{State: OperationCancelled}, err
417: 	}
418: 	ss := u.sprintService()
419: 	result := OperationResult{State: OperationComplete, Subject: operationFirstNonEmpty(req.Project+"/"+req.Sprint, req.Study)}
420: 	stage := sprint.PlanningStage(req.Stage)
421: 	switch req.Kind {
422: 	case OperationValidate:
423: 		validationReq := ValidationRequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint, Study: req.Study, Stage: req.Stage}
424: 		switch {
425: 		case req.Study != "":
426: 			validationReq.Subject = ValidationStudy
427: 		case req.Sprint != "":
428: 			validationReq.Subject = ValidationSprint
429: 		default:
430: 			validationReq.Subject = ValidationProject
431: 		}
432: 		validation, err := u.Validate(ctx, validationReq)
433: 		if err != nil {
434: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
435: 		}
436: 		result.Message = validation.Status
437: 		result.Findings = append(result.Findings, validation.Findings...)
438: 	case OperationSprintStatus:
439: 		r, err := ss.Status(req.Project, req.Sprint)
440: 		if err != nil {
441: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
442: 		}
443: 		result.Message = summarizeSprintStatus(r)
444: 	case OperationPrompt:
445: 		p, err := promptSprintStage(ss, req.Project, req.Sprint, stage)
446: 		if err != nil {
447: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
448: 		}
449: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(p.Prompt)
450: 	case OperationFlowDryRun:
451: 		r, err := runSprintFlow(ctx, ss, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.FlowRequest{To: stage, DryRun: true})
452: 		if err != nil {
453: 			result = operationWithSprintFindings(result, r.Findings)
454: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
455: 		}
456: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(r.Message)
457: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("flow to %s dry run", stage)
458: 	case OperationStageDryRun:
459: 		r, err := ss.FlowStage(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.FlowRequest{To: stage, DryRun: true})
460: 		if err != nil {
461: 			result = operationWithSprintFindings(result, r.Findings)
462: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
463: 		}
464: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(r.Message)
465: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("single-stage %s dry run", stage)
466: 	case OperationExecuteDryRun:
467: 		r, err := ss.Execute(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.ExecuteRequest{DryRun: true, TaskID: req.Task})
468: 		if err != nil {
469: 			result = operationWithSprintFindings(result, r.Findings)
470: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
471: 		}
472: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(r.Prompt)
473: 		result.Message = r.Message
474: 	case OperationExecuteStatus:
475: 		r, err := ss.Status(req.Project, req.Sprint)
476: 		if err != nil {
477: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
478: 		}
479: 		execute := summarizeExecute(r.ExecuteState)
480: 		if !execute.Available {
481: 			result.Message = execute.Message
482: 		} else {
483: 			result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("%d total: %d pending, %d running, %d complete, %d failed, %d cancelled", execute.Total, execute.Pending, execute.Running, execute.Complete, execute.Failed, execute.Cancelled)
484: 		}
485: 	case OperationReviewDryRun:
486: 		r, err := ss.Review(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.ReviewRequest{DryRun: true, Concurrency: req.Parallelism})
487: 		if err != nil {
488: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
489: 		}
490: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(r.Prompt)
491: 		result.Message = r.Message
492: 	case OperationReviewStatus:
493: 		r, err := ss.Status(req.Project, req.Sprint)
494: 		if err != nil {
495: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
496: 		}
497: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("%s verdict=%s fresh=%t next=%s", r.Verification.Review.ExecutionStatus, r.Verification.Review.Verdict, r.Verification.Review.Fresh, r.Verification.Review.NextAction)
498: 	case OperationSmokeStatus:
499: 		r, err := ss.VerificationStatus(req.Project, req.Sprint)
500: 		if err != nil {
501: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
502: 		}
503: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("%s verdict=%s fresh=%t run=%s issues=%d assessment=%s next=%s", r.Smoke.ExecutionStatus, r.Smoke.Verdict, r.Smoke.Fresh, r.Smoke.RunID, len(r.Smoke.Issues), r.Assessment, r.NextAction)
504: 	case OperationSmokeDryRun:

699: func fingerprintOperationInputs(root, canonical string, inputs []string) (string, error) {
700: 	hash := sha256.New()
701: 	_, _ = hash.Write([]byte(canonical))
702: 	for _, rel := range inputs {
703: 		path := filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(rel))
704: 		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
705: 		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
706: 			continue
707: 		}
708: 		if err != nil {
709: 			return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect governed input %s: %w", rel, err)
710: 		}
711: 		if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
712: 			return "", fmt.Errorf("governed input %s must not be a symbolic link", rel)
713: 		}
714: 		if info.IsDir() {
715: 			var files []string
716: 			if err := filepath.WalkDir(path, func(item string, entry fs.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
717: 				if walkErr != nil {
718: 					return walkErr
719: 				}
720: 				if entry.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
721: 					return fmt.Errorf("governed input %s must not contain symbolic links", rel)
722: 				}
723: 				if !entry.IsDir() {
724: 					files = append(files, item)
725: 				}
726: 				return nil
727: 			}); err != nil {
728: 				return "", fmt.Errorf("scan governed input %s: %w", rel, err)
729: 			}
730: 			sort.Strings(files)
731: 			for _, item := range files {
732: 				itemRel, _ := filepath.Rel(root, item)
733: 				if err := hashOperationFile(hash, item, filepath.ToSlash(itemRel)); err != nil {
734: 					return "", err
735: 				}
736: 			}
737: 			continue
738: 		}
739: 		if err := hashOperationFile(hash, path, rel); err != nil {
740: 			return "", err
741: 		}
742: 	}
743: 	return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil)), nil
744: }

746: func hashOperationFile(hash interface{ Write([]byte) (int, error) }, path, rel string) error {

750: 	}

752: 	_, _ = hash.Write(data)

787: func failedOperation(r OperationResult, err error) (OperationResult, error) {
788: 	if errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
789: 		r.State = OperationCancelled
790: 	} else {
791: 		r.State = OperationFailed
792: 	}
793: 	cause := displaySafe(err.Error())
794: 	code, category, guidance := "internal.error", "internal", "Inspect durable state and retry after correcting the reported cause."
795: 	if smokeErr, ok := sprint.AsSmokeError(err); ok {
796: 		code, category, guidance = smokeErr.Code, smokeErr.Category, smokeErr.Guidance
797: 		r.Message = operationFailureMessage(category)
798: 		r.Error = &OperationError{Code: code, Category: category, Operation: "smoke", Component: "sprint", Message: r.Message, Cause: cause, Guidance: guidance, Retryable: category == "process" || category == "timeout"}
799: 		return r, err
800: 	}
801: 	if qaErr, ok := sprint.AsQAError(err); ok {
802: 		category = string(qaErr.Category)
803: 		code = "qa." + category
804: 		guidance = qaErr.Recovery
805: 		switch qaErr.Category {
806: 		case sprint.QAErrorRuntimeUnavailable, sprint.QAErrorPersistenceFailure:
807: 			category = "runtime"
808: 		case sprint.QAErrorConflict:
809: 			category = "concurrency"
810: 		default:
811: 			category = "validation"
812: 		}
813: 		r.Message = operationFailureMessage(category)
814: 		r.Error = &OperationError{Code: code, Category: category, Operation: "qa", Component: "sprint", Message: r.Message, Cause: cause, Guidance: guidance, Retryable: qaErr.Category == sprint.QAErrorRuntimeUnavailable || qaErr.Category == sprint.QAErrorConflict}
815: 		return r, err
816: 	}
817: 	var projectRef project.RefError
818: 	var sprintRef sprint.RefError
819: 	switch {
820: 	case errors.Is(err, context.Canceled):
821: 		code, category, guidance = "workflow.cancelled", "cancellation", "Resume the operation when ready."
822: 	case errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrFlowStateMalformed), errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrFlowStateUnsupported),
823: 		errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrExecuteRunStateMissing), errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrExecuteRunStateMalformed), errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrExecuteRunStateUnsupported),
824: 		errors.As(err, &projectRef), errors.As(err, &sprintRef), len(r.Findings) > 0:
825: 		code, category, guidance = "validation.reference", "validation", "Complete or repair the reported governed evidence, inspect validation findings, and retry."
826: 	case errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrVerificationConflict), errors.Is(err, ErrStaleOperation):
827: 		code, category, guidance = "workflow.locked", "concurrency", "Inspect the active or stale study lock before retrying."
828: 	}
829: 	r.Message = operationFailureMessage(category)
830: 	r.Error = &OperationError{Code: code, Category: category, Operation: "workflow.operation", Component: "app", Message: r.Message, Cause: cause, Guidance: guidance, Retryable: category == "runtime" || category == "concurrency"}
831: 	return r, err
832: }

211: func (u dashboardUseCases) PrepareOperation(ctx context.Context, req OperationRequest) (Confirmation, error) {
212: 	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
213: 		return Confirmation{}, err
214: 	}
215: 	req.ExpectedFingerprint = ""
216: 	req = normalizeOperationRequest(req)
217: 	if err := validateOperationScope(req); err != nil {
218: 		return Confirmation{}, err
219: 	}
220: 	if err := validateQAOperationRequest(req); err != nil {
221: 		return Confirmation{}, err
222: 	}
223: 	if (req.Kind == OperationReviewStart || req.Kind == OperationReviewDryRun) && req.Parallelism <= 0 {
224: 		req.Parallelism = u.reviewConcurrency
225: 	}
226: 	c := Confirmation{Request: req, Subject: operationFirstNonEmpty(req.Project+"/"+req.Sprint, req.Study), Permission: "workspace policy enforced"}
227: 	switch req.Kind {
228: 	case OperationValidate, OperationPrompt, OperationFlowDryRun, OperationStageDryRun, OperationExecuteDryRun, OperationExecuteStatus, OperationReviewDryRun, OperationReviewStatus, OperationSmokeStatus, OperationQAStatus:
229: 		c.Scope = []string{req.Stage}
230: 		c.Warning = "runtime-free; no runtime-backed writes"
231: 	case OperationQADryRun:
232: 		if req.Suite == "smoke" {
233: 			smoke, err := u.sprintService().RunSmoke(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.SmokeRequest{DryRun: true})
234: 			if err != nil {
235: 				return c, err
236: 			}
237: 			c.Scope = []string{"canonical containing smoke selection", smoke.ScopeKind + " " + smoke.Scope}
238: 			c.Warning = "RUNTIME-FREE SMOKE PREFLIGHT; NO HARNESS INVOCATION"
239: 			break
240: 		}
241: 		mapped, err := u.QAMap(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
242: 		if err != nil {
243: 			return c, err
244: 		}
245: 		c.Scope = []string{fmt.Sprintf("deterministic map %s", mapped.MapFingerprint), fmt.Sprintf("%d changed paths in %d bounded shards", mapped.ChangedPaths, mapped.TotalShards)}
246: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME-FREE; TARGET AND GOVERNED INPUTS READ-ONLY; NO QA STATE WRITE"
247: 	case OperationQAStart, OperationQAResume:
248: 		if req.Suite == "smoke" {
249: 			c.Runtime, c.Mutates = true, true
250: 			c.Scope = []string{"one canonical smoke harness invocation", "one smoke.md and flow-state update"}
251: 			c.Warning = "RUNTIME + EXTERNAL HARNESS EVIDENCE; IMPLEMENTATION TARGET READ-ONLY"
252: 			break
253: 		}
254: 		mapped, err := u.QAMap(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
255: 		if err != nil {
256: 			return c, err
257: 		}
258: 		if req.Task != "" {
259: 			owned := false
260: 			for _, shard := range mapped.Shards {
261: 				owned = owned || shard.ID == req.Task
262: 			}
263: 			if !owned {
264: 				return c, fmt.Errorf("selected QA shard is not owned by the current map")
265: 			}
266: 		}
267: 		c.Runtime, c.Mutates = true, true
268: 		c.Scope = []string{fmt.Sprintf("deterministic map %s", mapped.MapFingerprint), fmt.Sprintf("bounded concurrency and %d total shards", mapped.TotalShards)}
269: 		if req.Task != "" {
270: 			c.Scope = append(c.Scope, "map-owned shard "+req.Task)
271: 		}
272: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + PRIVATE QA STATE WRITE; IMPLEMENTATION TARGET READ-ONLY"
273: 	case OperationQARecover:
274: 		c.Mutates = true
275: 		c.Scope = []string{"QA pointer, digest, interrupted ownership, flow summary, and retention reconciliation"}
276: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME-FREE QA RECOVERY; NO CHILD WORK"
277: 	case OperationSprintStatus:
278: 		c.Mutates = true
279: 		c.Scope = []string{"all sprint stages", "execute and Conformance Review state"}
280: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME-FREE; MAY REFRESH FLOW-STATE.JSON"
281: 	case OperationFlow:
282: 		c.Runtime = true
283: 		c.Mutates = true
284: 		c.Scope = []string{"planning stages through " + req.Stage}
285: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + WORKSPACE MUTATION"
286: 	case OperationStage:
287: 		c.Runtime = true
288: 		c.Mutates = true
289: 		c.Scope = []string{"selected planning stage only: " + req.Stage}
290: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + WORKSPACE MUTATION; PREREQUISITES MUST ALREADY BE VALID"
291: 	case OperationExecuteStart, OperationExecuteResume:
292: 		c.Runtime = true
293: 		c.Mutates = true
294: 		c.Scope = []string{"execute tasks"}
295: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + APPROVED TARGET MUTATION"
296: 	case OperationReviewStart:
297: 		c.Runtime = true
298: 		c.Mutates = true
299: 		c.Scope = []string{"one read-only Conformance Review worker per selected contract plus handbook", fmt.Sprintf("bounded parallelism: %d", req.Parallelism)}
300: 		if req.RestartReview {
301: 			c.Scope = append(c.Scope, "discard resumable Conformance Review checkpoints and start fresh sessions")
302: 		}
303: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + REVIEW ARTIFACT WRITE (TARGET READ-ONLY)"
304: 	case OperationSmokeDryRun, OperationSmokeStart:
305: 		preview, err := u.sprintService().RunSmoke(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.SmokeRequest{Level: req.Level, Suite: req.Suite, Test: req.Test, ForceReview: req.ForceReview, OverrideConfirmed: req.ForceReview, OverrideRationale: req.OverrideRationale, DryRun: true})
306: 		if err != nil {
307: 			return c, err
308: 		}
309: 		c.Runtime = true
310: 		c.Mutates = req.Kind == OperationSmokeStart
311: 		c.Scope = []string{fmt.Sprintf("%s %s", preview.ScopeKind, preview.Scope), preview.ScopeRationale, "prerequisites: " + strings.Join(preview.Prerequisites, ", "), "duration/cost: " + preview.DurationClass + "/" + preview.CostClass, fmt.Sprintf("timeout: %s (source: %s)", preview.EffectiveTimeout, preview.TimeoutSource), "safe command: " + preview.SafeArgv, "evidence roots: " + strings.Join(preview.EvidenceRoots, ", ")}
312: 		c.Warning = "EXTERNAL HARNESS + SMOKE ARTIFACT WRITE; RAW EVIDENCE REMAINS EXTERNAL"
313: 	case OperationVerifyDryRun, OperationVerifyStart:
314: 		c.Runtime, c.Mutates = true, req.Kind == OperationVerifyStart
315: 		c.Scope = []string{"complete execute evidence", "current Conformance Review", "Conformance Review-gated containing smoke scope"}
316: 		if req.ForceReview {
317: 			c.Scope = append(c.Scope, "DIAGNOSTIC OVERRIDE: "+req.OverrideRationale)
318: 		}
319: 		c.Warning = "ORDERED REVIEW -> SMOKE VERIFICATION; CANONICAL EVIDENCE ONLY AFTER VALIDATION"
320: 	case OperationStudyStart, OperationStudyResume:
321: 		if req.Parallelism < 1 || req.Parallelism > 64 {
322: 			return c, fmt.Errorf("parallelism must be between 1 and 64")
323: 		}
324: 		c.Runtime = true
325: 		c.Mutates = true
326: 		c.Scope = []string{fmt.Sprintf("study run-loop with %d parallel workers", req.Parallelism)}
327: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + STUDY STATE MUTATION"
328: 	case OperationStudyCancel:
329: 		c.Mutates = true
330: 		c.Scope = []string{"active study run-loop"}
331: 		c.Warning = "CANCEL ACTIVE RUN LOOP"
332: 	default:
333: 		return c, fmt.Errorf("unsupported operation %q", req.Kind)
334: 	}
335: 	if req.Project != "" {
336: 		if req.Sprint != "" {
337: 			c.Paths = []string{"projects/" + req.Project + "/sprints/" + req.Sprint}
338: 			c.DurableRefreshPath = "/api/v1/projects/" + req.Project + "/sprints/" + req.Sprint
339: 		} else {
340: 			c.Paths = []string{"projects/" + req.Project}
341: 			c.DurableRefreshPath = "/api/v1/projects/" + req.Project
342: 		}
343: 	} else {
344: 		c.Paths = []string{"studies/" + req.Study}
345: 		c.DurableRefreshPath = "/api/v1/studies/" + req.Study
346: 	}
347: 	if c.Mutates {
348: 		if req.Project != "" {
349: 			c.MutationClass = "sprint_mutation"
350: 		} else {
351: 			c.MutationClass = "study_mutation"
352: 		}
353: 	} else {
354: 		c.MutationClass = "read_only"
355: 	}
356: 	if c.Runtime {
357: 		c.ModelSource = operationRuntimeIdentity(req, u.stageRuntime)
358: 	}
359: 	c.Prerequisites = operationPrerequisites(req)
360: 	canonical, err := canonicalOperationRequest(req)
361: 	if err != nil {
362: 		return c, err
363: 	}
364: 	c.CanonicalRequest = canonical
365: 	c.GovernedInputs = governedOperationInputs(req)
366: 	fingerprintBasis := canonical + "\nruntime=" + c.ModelSource + "\nscope=" + strings.Join(c.Scope, "\x00")
367: 	fingerprint, err := fingerprintOperationInputs(u.root, fingerprintBasis, c.GovernedInputs)
368: 	if err != nil {
369: 		return c, err
370: 	}
371: 	c.InputFingerprint = fingerprint
372: 	c.Request.ExpectedFingerprint = fingerprint
373: 	return c, nil
374: }

376: func validateQAOperationRequest(req OperationRequest) error {
377: 	switch req.Kind {
378: 	case OperationQAStatus, OperationQADryRun, OperationQAStart, OperationQAResume, OperationQARecover:
379: 	default:
380: 		return nil
381: 	}
382: 	if req.Study != "" || req.Stage != "" || req.Model != "" || req.Level != "" || req.Test != "" || req.Timeout != "" || req.ForceReview || req.RestartReview || req.OverrideRationale != "" || len(req.ReviewFocus) > 0 || len(req.Sources) > 0 || len(req.Dimensions) > 0 || req.Parallelism != 0 {
383: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA operations accept only project, sprint, and a map-owned shard")
384: 	}
385: 	if req.Suite != "" && req.Suite != "smoke" {
386: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA suite must be smoke")
387: 	}
388: 	if req.Suite != "" && req.Kind != OperationQAStart && req.Kind != OperationQADryRun {
389: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA suite is valid only for start or dry-run")
390: 	}
391: 	if req.Suite != "" && req.Task != "" {
392: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA suite and shard focus are mutually exclusive")
393: 	}
394: 	if req.Task != "" && req.Kind != OperationQAStart && req.Kind != OperationQAResume {
395: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA shard is valid only for start or resume")
396: 	}
397: 	return nil
398: }
